preparation_lifecycle: deep-copy model snapshot; input coordinate array made read-only
paired GlobalAssembler K/M assembly exactly once
apply existing DynamicDofReducer for fixed/free and supported reduction mapping
retain sparse full/reduced matrices and identity digests in this instance
prepared_dynamic_system.public_mutability: Matrix and mapping accessors return defensive copies; physical snapshot is canonical immutable bytes; identity fields are read-only properties.
prepared_dynamic_system.reuse: require_compatible checks physical identity and assembly chunk policy without assembling K/M again.

cache_policy.assembly_plan: retained only by its PreparedDynamicSystem instance

identity_contract.canonical_digest_implementation: Reuse solveur.io.checkpoint_common.checkpoint_signature for canonical JSON and solveur.io.manifest.content_digest for sparse content bytes.
identity_contract.domain_separation: Each identity envelope carries an explicit identity_domain and identity_schema_version.

includes: homogeneous fixed-DOF set and active DOF signature
full and reduced K/M sparse-content digests
existing dynamic load function/table/factors and harmonic frequency grid parameters
excitation_identity.future_channel_contract: Deferred to WP03; no channel implementation added here.

identity_contract.execution_identity: Not assembled as a new general framework in WP02; the existing Newmark checkpoint signature binds its solver parameters and excitation separately from PreparedDynamicSystem operator reuse.

admissible_domain.density: Finite positive density required for each used material.
admissible_domain.boundary_conditions: Existing fixed homogeneous BoundaryCondition representation only.
admissible_domain.discrete_entities: ConcentratedMass and linear springs only on DDL already supplied by supported structural elements.
excluded: springs or masses adding structural DDL
admissible_domain.positive_definiteness: Not asserted by shared preparation; each consuming numerical method must apply its preregistered M/K definiteness contract. No eigensolver or new positivity threshold was introduced in WP02.

bound_inputs: geometry, connectivity, used materials, units and schema
fixed DOFs, concentrated masses, springs, MPC/RBE/contact entities
analysis method and dynamic parameters except checkpoint storage paths/policy
newmark_checkpoint.storage_schema: Existing NPZ checkpoint schema v1 retained and readable.
newmark_checkpoint.legacy_policy: A checkpoint with an unversioned signature can be decoded for inspection but is rejected for resume with an explicit readable-but-not-safe-to-resume error. Historical checkpoint bytes are not rewritten.

commands: python -m pytest -q tests/unit/test_prepared_dynamic_system.py tests/unit/test_analysis_features.py tests/unit/test_dynamic_initial_conditions.py tests/unit/test_dynamic_controls.py tests/unit/test_assembly_plan.py tests/unit/test_mitc4_dynamics.py tests/unit/test_dynamic_checkpoint.py tests/integration/test_hex8_workflow.py tests/integration/test_hex20_workflow.py tests/integration/test_beam2_workflow.py
verification.numeric_oracle_claim: Direct-versus-prepared assembly establishes integration/non-regression only; it is not claimed as independent physical validation.
verification.performance_limit: Single-element storage smoke only; no RSS study, repeated timing campaign, or large-model performance claim. Assembly diagnostics preserve timings but they are not qualification evidence.

gate_evidence.QF0212_G02_global_gate: OPEN; later WP contracts/consumers and overall architecture remain to be assessed
gate_evidence.QF0212_G05_legacy_route_subset: PASS for the targeted regression campaign; release-level gate remains open

deferred: reduced modal, harmonic, and transient solvers
modal basis and damping contracts in consuming routes
